motivation: Accuracy-first reset after I027. Determine which exported B31J intersection declarations actually own flexibility, prove the locked bend-angle population and current smooth-90 basis, and demonstrate that CAESAR load-case formula text does not uniquely identify the solved state. Do not introduce a beam/shear/bend/tee candidate in this iteration.
questions: What are the exact TYPE/NODE/BRANCHNODE records for all 13 active INT_PTR declarations, and which are B31J tees versus joints?
Which active intersection declarations can alter flexibility rather than stress/SIF reporting only, and which are represented by the current TYPE=3 three-leg tee implementation?
Are all 12 locked bends 90 degrees when the authoritative INPUT_BASIC_ELEMENT_DATA DELTA vectors are used?
Does the current solver's B31J profile nevertheless force smooth90FlexibilityCorrection=false, selecting the 1.65/h basis instead of the optional B31J 1.3/h smooth-90 basis?
How different are CAESAR L17 versus L19 despite both being W+P1, and L2 versus L20 despite both being W+T1+P1?
Is replacing the configured 1e13 N/m/Nm/rad default restraint stiffness with exact fixed DOFs negligible at the locked reaction scale?
Where do the accepted-baseline L19 source-end-action failures overlap active intersection declarations, bend adjacency and otherwise plain straight pipe?
authorityNotes: Hexagon CAESAR II 14 identifies intersection types 1-6 as B31J tees and 7-13 as B31J joints.
Hexagon states B31J smooth 90-degree bends use 1.3/h while B31.3 uses 1.65/h; the controlling Smooth 90 setting must therefore be resolved for this all-90-degree benchmark.

Hexagon states load-case Friction Multiplier, Elastic Modulus, Elbow Stiffening Pressure and Elbow Stiffening Elastic Modulus are load-case controls and are not encoded completely by the CASE formula text.
For B31.3-2020 and later, B31J joint default flexibility is 1.0; joint declarations are not treated as missing stiffness solely because INT_PTR is active.
acceptanceInterpretation: No solver/profile mechanics change is permitted in I028.
Do not promote any INT_PTR declaration to a flexibility defect until its TYPE and B31J flexibility applicability are established.
If all bends are 90 degrees and Smooth 90 authority is unresolved, elevate that control ahead of Bend Axial Shape as the next bend-specific gate.
Same-formula CAESAR output differences must be retained as proof that a reusable validation profile needs explicit load-case control state.
Default-restraint finite-stiffness effects may be deprioritized only after a numerical displacement/rotation bound is recorded.
No kappa, thermal coefficient, bend coefficient, tee factor or reaction target may be selected from benchmark fit.
